"finlay" Finlay Wilkinson (1963): regression environment mean, optionally log scale. "shukla" Shukla's (1972) stability variance sigma2 removing linear regression environmental index (s2), F tests pooled error (plot scale). "wricke" Wricke's (1962) ecovalence (plot scale) share interaction. "kang" Kang's (1993) yield-stability statistic YS: rank mean (highest = g), adjusted LSD, plus stability rating Shukla's test (-8, -4, -2 0.01, 0.05, 0.10).
